evals.name: clean-verification
evals.prompt: Verify this completed research package before I ask to close it.
evals.expected_output: Performs read-only checks of acceptance criteria, claim/source traceability, evidence labels, contradiction/freshness handling, memory integrity, configured subsystem identities/hierarchy/links, and reports pass/warning/blocking findings without mutation.

evals.name: missing-contradiction
evals.prompt: The conclusion relies on one authoritative source and the claim is marked Verified, but nobody searched for contradicting or qualifying evidence. Verify it.
evals.expected_output: Treats the missing contradiction search for a conclusion-critical claim as blocking unless the approved scope explicitly accepts the limitation; does not equate an authoritative source alone with completed verification.

evals.name: not-established
evals.prompt: We couldn't find evidence that feature X exists, so the report says 'Verified: feature X does not exist.' Please verify.
evals.expected_output: Flags the inference as invalid: lack of establishing evidence must not become proof of absence; requires an appropriate Not established state unless direct evidence supports the negative proposition.
